about: Architecture ratchets (refactor plan docs/internal/refactor-plan-2026-10-01.md, stage 0 item 2). Each number is measured from the working tree (never git) and must EQUAL the recorded value: higher fails, lower fails too — lower the baseline in the same commit as the change that reduced it. Retired: localizeOptOuts (infoRaw/reportErrorVerbatim/localizeHints) counted three symbols that no longer exist, so it could never move; the property it stood for, that the output layers print the text they are given, is pinned by advice-matrix.check.ts (info() and reportError write rendered advice un-rewritten).

rawArgvScans.comment: invariant (rf6): membership/prefix scans over argv-like names (argv/args/rawArgv/launchArgv .includes/.indexOf/.find/... , indexOf("--"), startsWith("--, slice(2)) in tools/framework/{entry,integration,core,commands} plus tools/clawwright.ts must be the tokenizer's, an entry seam, or an exempt line recorded with a reason — total counts occurrences including exempt ones, so any new scan fails. 38 -> 37 (rf6-p16): rollback --operation uses the shared path-segment grammar, its own prefix scan is gone. 37 -> 36 (stage 7 S2.2): parseCall and execute.ts's --json probe read the action pick from selectAction (core/command/parse.ts); their own first-word scans are gone. 36 -> 40 (stage 7 S2.4): core/values/kinds.ts arrives (its interval wrapper's message-prefix slice, and the ssh/text leading-dash refusals over one raw value), and the interval wrappers in backup/watch install slice parseInterval's refusal prefix — all one-value refusals, exempted with reasons; schedule.ts's stale exemption is deleted with the flip that removed its line. Back at 36 (stage 7 S2.4, second pass): the dash refusals are expressed without startsWith (raw[0] === "-"), the install wrappers call kinds.ts's shared intervalRangeRefusal (whose own line is slice-based and adds no scan), and the kinds.ts interval wrapper's line is the one exempted occurrence — the same nature schedule.ts's deleted exemption had. 36 -> 35 (stage 7 S2.8): step()'s two branch-local `--` tests collapse into one hoisted const, the completion table's actionArgument find is gone with the transition-table refactor, and the no-slot/unknown refusal no longer scans (token[0] === "-"); S2.8 third pass: the pending option's declared-long-token refusal moved wholly into step(), so the driver's dead lookahead and its exempt line are gone, and the dashed lookups are restricted to flags and options as HEAD's parser did

tools/framework/integration/gate.ts.reason: the bare-`--` boundary itself (beforeBareDoubleDash/requestsHelp/requestsShortHelp: the one function every help request reads through); splitLeadingAppFlag: the leading --app pair the gate splits off before any command declaration applies; helpWithoutDeployment's first-word test: argv[0] is the command position, an option there is left to the caller; misplacedAppFlag: its fallback for a command whose declarations the entry does not know (the declaration-known path is the tokenizer, differentially pinned by gate-dispatch.check.ts), and the lines that compare the token the tokenizer itself refused (UnknownArgumentError.argument) by equality — whether it sits behind an options-end `--` is tokenizeLenient's answer, not a scan

writeTargetsUnresolved.comment: Bound write targets not statically proven temp-rooted or anchored. Operator-approved memory model fixture adds 15 explicit UNKNOWN approximations: 14 guarded pathname/descriptor and VM-adapter sites plus one serialized Node invocation. Canonical boundaries, descriptor leases and cancellation were exercised independently; static uncertainty is not labeled CLEAN. Exact measured total is 438, with zero anchored/unbound writes and no allow entries. Future unreviewed growth remains forbidden.

ownProductExpectations.comment: stage 7 S0.5 (independent expectations, invariant I11): check()/assert.* assertions whose EXPECTED operand and ACTUAL operand share a symbol imported from tools/framework — one product mutation moves both sides. A predicate argument nested in the actual operand (.includes/.startsWith/.endsWith/.match) counts as the expected role. Initial baseline = the measured state after converting the round 18/19 offender sites to literal expectations (schedule crontab read/update/confirm refusals, host probe evidence and --choices, destroy --confirm-name mismatch, lock reinstall advice, recover-env refusals, system-install unknown-command/no-save lines). Exempt: a file a registered negative control covers (C1-C8, C9, C11), a line marked `// control: <id>`. The baseline was first recorded at 301 with the initial scanner. The measurement was then completed (derived locals, template interpolations, combined imports) and the converted sites moved to token-array assertions; the recorded total is now 391 (was 301) — a measurement widening of the new ratchet, not growth. A file absent from `files` must not gain one. S3.2: the 11 sites in set-validate.check.ts became control-exempt when controls C80-C82 registered that check file (exemption is per FILE — architecture.check.ts's CONTROLLED_FILES), so the recorded total is 380 (was 391); a recorded decrease, not growth. C83 registers set-validate-image.check.ts, adding a file exemption for 2 sites (not stronger expectations), so the measured total is 378 (was 380). S1.4: control C127 registers completion-behaviour.check.ts, adding a file exemption for its 3 sites (not stronger expectations), so the measured total is 375 (was 378). Stage 7 S2.5: the one site in set-command.check.ts became a structural assertion with the local-facts-of-arguments migration so the recorded total is 374 (was 375); a recorded decrease, not growth. S2.8: control C143 registers parse.check.ts, exempting its 4 sites per FILE — the recorded total is 370 (was 374); a recorded decrease, not growth. S2.6b records the decrease: gate-commands.check.ts is exempt as negative control C191's check (remove-app's confirm: true sets --yes), 15 own-product expectations fewer (370 -> 355).
